Per the file, a node MUST NOT vote for (per the file) a block containing a (per the file) FEC set failing to (per the file) satisfy the second family of constraints.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: The proposal will not impact normal leaders. Per the file, blocks produced by malicious or extremely buggy nodes may become invalid. Per the file, this will simplify the (per the file) protocol for core contributors.

sections.heading: Drawbacks *(Optional)*
paragraphs: Per the file, there's a standard philosophy (per the file) in computing that software ought to be maximally conservative in what (per the file) it produces and maximally liberal (per the file) in what it accepts. The file goes against that, but (per the file) I think that maxim fails to apply when multiple implementations (per the file) need to match exactly (per the file) in what they accept.
